points: Of 1,010 non-tech S&P 1200 companies, 4% reported AI-enabled cost reduction material enough to disclose in H1 2026
Gartner names four levers: preventing losses, buying less or differently, employing less capital, reorganising work
Prediction: by 2029, 60% of AI-deploying firms will have a function mapping AI cost to value
read: Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo 2026 Orlando, Day 3 highlights (Nate Suda, Daryl Plummer)
take: Hard evidence of AI savings is still rare at company level. CFOs will ask CIOs for disclosed results, not pilots, in 2027 budgets.
title: Gartner: only 4% of big firms report material AI cost savings
